## Primary prompt

```text
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: revised approval-gate Android tablet landscape dashboard concept at exact 1536 x 1024
Input roles: Image 1 supplies the real Clinical Calendar regions, controls, and navigation; Image 2 is the canonical Axion Delta that must remain faithfully recognizable; Image 3 supplies dense irregular cube-hull panel layering and localized green lights; Image 4 supplies green radial instrumentation; Image 5 supplies deep recessed ribs, conduits, grates, and asymmetrical Borg interior material language. References are mood/form only: do not reproduce characters, film scenes, logos, or text.
Primary request: Make Containment Drone 47-Alpha unmistakably more Borg-like while remaining an original, readable, implementable clinical application. Build an asymmetrical assimilated chassis of interlocking blackened gunmetal plates, exposed conduits, uneven ribs, recessed circuit trenches, sensor apertures, clamp-like joints, and layered hull fragments. Avoid the regular generic rectangular dashboard feeling. Use green illumination sparingly from within seams and instruments, with deep black negative space.
Required anchors: the canonical Axion Delta is a prominent actionable APPLICATION MENU trigger integrated into the upper-left command crown. A large circular segmented green Clinical Placement progress wheel, inspired by the radial reference instrumentation but original, dominates the upper-right bay. Around it show live metrics labelled COMPLETED HOURS, SCHEDULED HOURS, REMAINING HOURS, OVER-TARGET HOURS. NEEDS ATTENTION occupies a separate lower-right recessed bay. Dominant CALENDAR remains central, CLINICAL PLACEMENTS left, PLANNING below Calendar.
Shared controls verbatim: crown actions APPLICATION MENU, ADD SCHEDULE, HELP, NOTIFICATIONS, SYNCHRONIZATION, STUDENT PROFILE. Bottom navigation exactly TODAY, CALENDAR, PLACEMENTS, ATTENTION, SETTINGS. Use PRECEPTOR, never Supervisor.
Semantic palette: green Clinical Session, blue-gray Work Shift, amber scheduled/Academic Assignment, hatched Protected Day, red urgent, bone-white data text, each with non-color marks.
Constraints: exact 1536x1024 front-facing orthographic full-screen UI; fictional data; live-widget-sized bays; readable at tablet scale; no people, faces, bodies, drones, movie titles, slogans, scene backgrounds, device bezel, perspective, excessive neon, Axion distortion, other theme identity, real personal data, or watermark.
```

## Crown correction

```text
Change only the top command crown controls. Keep the Axion Delta APPLICATION MENU control unchanged. To its right there must be exactly five controls, once each, in this exact order: ADD SCHEDULE, HELP, NOTIFICATIONS, SYNCHRONIZATION, STUDENT PROFILE. Replace the second duplicate ADD SCHEDULE control with STUDENT PROFILE and its person icon; retain the first ADD SCHEDULE. Preserve every other pixel and all other text as closely as possible.
```
